title: Two Slits
intro: Both slits are open, so the packet goes through both and interferes with itself. Bright fringes are where the two paths add; dark fringes are where they cancel. The mines sit near dark fringes. Faster packets spread less on the way, but the fringe pattern also fans out with time (spacing ≈ 2πt / slit separation), so watch where the dark bands are when you observe.
naiveSkip: introductory level: in 2D, slit diffraction spreads P_T thinly whatever you do; the Mach–Zehnder levels (3-2, 5-1) carry the interference lessons
